title: Granite-4.0-H-Tiny decode frontier: area vs tokens/s
subtitle: P7.6 fixture for the frontier explorer, matching the contract P7.4/P7.5 (builder E3) emit. Decode only (D25); no safety margins (D28).
decode_only: Every point is a decode design point in D15's batched-synchronous regime. Prefill is out of P7 (D25) and no prefill figure appears here.
provisioning_stance: No point carries a safety margin, a derate or a guard band: D28 makes the frontier itself the statement of how close a point runs. The loader refuses any such field by name.

provenance.author: P7.6 hand fixture. The eight sweep points are the REAL candidate rows of docs/qif/dse/granite_lanes_banks/dse_report.json (fws_qif_dse, Wave D); the ninth is the shipped Granite atlas run. The shared-digital area term and the shared-digital utilization are the two fields no producer emits, and they carry their marks.
grounded: throughput.tokens_per_s and throughput.decode_step_s of all nine points are measured off each candidate's own timeline
area.terms.analog_mm2 is the P3.6 enumerated_macro_silicon accounting
utilization analog_macro is derived from the reference run's MEASURED macro duty cycle and each point's MEASURED decode step
packing.waste_pct is the reference mapping's measured unowned-column census
the knee law R + C / lanes is fitted to the four measured decode steps and reproduces all four to 1e-13
provenance.note: The x axis exists only because of a PLACEHOLDER. The shipped shared-digital card declares no area_mm2, so every real candidate carries the same silicon and the Wave D front collapsed to one point - its own front_shape note says so. The placeholder makes the picture the frontier explorer is FOR; it is marked at every point and it is the first thing P7.4 must replace with a declared card area.

x.basis: analog floor + shared digital, both named per point

y.label: decode throughput

device_classes.label: analog macro slots
device_classes.basis: the 6400 enumerated slots of the 10 analog chiplets

knobs.label: shared-chiplet vector lanes
knobs.basis: cim.cards.sa.vector_lanes - the scan engine's declared width (D13)

knobs.label: analog allocation granularity (mux slots)
knobs.basis: cim.cards.ctt.bank_depth; the card declares adc_mux = 4, so 1, 2 and 4 are the values it admits

knobs.label: shared digital chiplet count
knobs.basis: constant at 10 over this sweep: no axis here moves it, which is half the reason the front is nearly vertical

provisioning.basis: the enumerated inventory of the candidate's own mapping (fws_qif_dse candidate rows); chips are integers (D21).

area.basis: 6400 enumerated analog macro slots x macro_footprint_mm2 2.0204136 = 12930.64704 mm2 (the P3.6 enumerated_macro_silicon accounting, measured) + a PLACEHOLDER shared-digital term of 10 chiplets x 512 lanes x 0.0005 mm2/lane. The shipped digital card declares no area_mm2, so without the placeholder this axis is constant and the whole front collapses to one point - which is exactly what the Wave D sweep reported as front_shape flat_area.

throughput.basis: measured at the decode terminal off this candidate's OWN timeline (ADJ-6), fws_qif_dse mapped path.

utilization.basis: analog active time per macro per decode step 4.732818486437201e-07 s (the reference run's measured macros[].duty_cycle x its measured decode step) divided by THIS point's decode step. At the cell floor every bank fires once per step, so the numerator does not move with the digital knobs (P7 Fact 1). On the reference point it reproduces the measured duty cycle exactly.

utilization.uncovered: no producer emits per-device occupancy for the shared digital chiplet: the Wave D report carries times and energies, not device utilization. D28 requires it at every point, so it is drawn as the unknown hatch until P7.4 emits it - an absent measurement, never a zero.

packing.basis: unowned stored columns 2671424 of 9830400 enumerated (6400 slots x 1536 stored columns) on the reference mapping. This is the COLUMN accounting; D27's waste is counted in CELLS and is larger, because a tile whose K is below the card's rows leaves row remainder no column census sees. No producer emits the cell census yet (P7.2).

atlas.basis: the shipped P3.6/P4 artifact of this exact design point

knee.basis: the four measured decode steps at bank_depth 1 fit step(lanes) = R + C / lanes EXACTLY (to 1e-13) with residual R = 5.815777759308828e-04 s and C = 0.2989476378722559 s x lanes. The knee is the smallest swept width at which the digital term C / lanes drops BELOW the residual the digital knob cannot move: at 512 lanes the term is 1.004 x R, at 1024 it is 0.502 x R. Past 1024 every doubling buys a term already smaller than the floor, and pays area for it.
knee.caveat: the residual is NOT the analog m-pass time: analog activity is 4.732818486437201e-07 s per macro per step, three orders below R. What R actually contains is the part of the decode step no vector-lane count moves, and decomposing it per device class is P7.4's job, not this fixture's.

relaxations.reason: the shipped digital card declares no area_mm2 (an ABSENT law, not a measured zero). Every x coordinate here is analog silicon plus that placeholder; the RANKING is optimistic by whatever the real card costs.

relaxations.value: no value at any of the 9 points
relaxations.reason: D28 requires per-device utilization at every point and no producer emits it for the digital class. It draws as the unknown hatch. This is the field the frontier explorer most needs from P7.4.

D27 counts waste in CELLS. The only census any producer emits is columns, which misses the row remainder of every tile whose K is below the card's rows. The cell census arrives with P7.2's dense packer and will be larger.

it is the shipped Granite atlas run, carried here because it is the only point with a placement document to click through to. It shares the sweep's analog inventory and its bank_depth is read from its 5610 placed tiles; it was not re-run for this fixture and is marked in_sweep false.

relaxations.value: 3 of 256 steps lowered at every point
relaxations.reason: ADJ-6: the DAG grows linearly in decode length, so each candidate lowers a bounded window and the rest is an extrapolation the consumer declares.
